text: 31-year-old female. The patient reports experiencing chronic diarrhea on most days for the past four months. She mentions lower abdominal discomfort and cramping, which is relieved by diarrhea. text: Thank you for the details; the relief of pain after defecation, urgency, mucus, and incomplete evacuation strongly suggest inflammatory bowel disease or an infectious etiology like Campylobacter. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Irritable Bowel Syndrome with Campylobacter infection (or IBD).
